gap: Phone When sheet: Cancel keeps a repeat-rule change, so Stop Repeating then Cancel silently ends the series. SEED (clock Tue 2026-03-10 09:00 America/New_York, phone 390x844 with touch, lists as recur-check): things-todos=[{id:'t1',title:'Take out bins',when:'2026-03-10',project:'p_house',repeat:{mode:'schedule',every:1,unit:'week',weekdays:[2,5],ends:{after:10}}}], route #/project/p_house. STEPS: tap the row (its card opens), tap the card's repeat chip (the 'When?' sheet opens with a Cancel button), tap Stop Repeating, tap Cancel, close the card, tick the row. EXPECTED: Cancel discards what was done in the sheet. The sheet's own rule is that a committed change turns Cancel into Done (when.js: 'Reminders commit as they change, so the sheet's Cancel becomes Done'; Add Reminder does flip it), so a sheet that still says Cancel promises nothing has changed. The person's Tue/Fri rule with 'ends after 10' should survive, and ticking should create the next one on Fri 13 Mar. ACTUAL (2/2 clean runs): after Stop Repeating the button still reads 'Cancel'. After Cancel, storage has repeat:null and the card's repeat chip is gone. Ticking the row leaves only t1 [x] with no next occurrence, so the series has ended, the Fri 13 occurrence is never created, and the rule the person set up (weekdays and the count) is gone. Turning repeat back on gives a default Weekly and restarts the count at 1. VARIANT (2/2): an accidental tap on Thu, then Cancel, keeps weekdays [2,4,5], so ticking on Tue 10 creates the next one on Thu 12 instead of Fri 13. A kind change (Weekly to Monthly) also survives Cancel. No page errors. CAUSE: repeat.js saves every change through updateTodo, but when.js only relabels Cancel as Done in commitReminder. Repro: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-pr-Desktop-dev-Todo/7de92c54-84d7-47b2-acf0-63c627b2ff05/scratchpad/recur-r5-c3/repro-phone-sheet-cancel-keeps-stop-repeating.mjs (prints REPRODUCED 2/2). ALSO TRIED, no break: 9 seeded random UI walks (1 and 2 tabs, 60 to 90 steps: row, card, Cmd+K, toolbar and heading Complete All, card title, notes and checklist with Escape, Enter or the card checkbox (tick and untick), picker rule edits including Ends, Move to Inbox, area or project, Backspace delete, Clear completed, Delete Heading, reload, next day). After every step they checked for one open repeating occurrence per series, no duplicate occurrence numbers, no new to-do except a next occurrence, no take-back of an edited or completed occurrence, typed titles and notes kept, and no page errors. Not claimed: after the card completes or reopens a to-do that the filter then hides, the card vanishes but that to-do stays selected, so Backspace or Cmd+K acts on it invisibly.
why: Phone When sheet: Cancel doesn't undo a repeat change, so Stop Repeating then Cancel silently ends the series and loses the rule (the next occurrence is never created)
